Bengaluru Court Blocks Defamatory Posts on Nani's Film 'The Paradise'

A Bengaluru court has issued an injunction against the posting of allegedly defamatory content concerning the upcoming film 'The Paradise', starring Nani. The court's order aims to prevent the dissemination of derogatory posts ahead of the film's release, scheduled for September 24. The legal action was taken to restrain such content from appearing on social media.
